title: Transcriptional signature of ABMR
description: Acute rejection (AR) is closely associated with renal allograft dysfunction. We utilize RNA-Seq and bioinformatics methods to investigate the characterization of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) of patients with acute renal allograft rejection.
